title: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man, You're Under Arrest
writer: Enrico Zuccarini, Jesus Maria Elorietta, José Luis Navarro
actors: Espartaco Santoni, Peter Lee Lawrence, Aldo Sambrell
plot: The sole survivor, named Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), of a Northern slaughter seeks vendetta. After suffering atrocity, Kid executes a single-handedly revenge, he ravages, he hits and kills each person involved in the massacre....
